title: Asuka 120% Limited: Burning Fest. Limited
overview:
Exhilarating! Refreshing! Full throttle!! Those 11 characters are back and powered up.

Asuka 120% Limited is a 2D fighting game set at Ryouran Academy for Girls, where the school's clubs battle in the yearly Mega Fight Tournament to win a bigger budget. Choose one of eleven girls, each fighting with moves drawn from her own club, and face off in timed best-of-three bouts. Fill the Burning Gauge by landing and taking hits to unleash a super move, or let it climb to 120% for a short burst of extra power.

- Story Mode with dialogue before and after every fight
- Versus Mode against a friend or the computer, with saved records
- Ranking Mode survival challenge
- Adjustable difficulty, game speed, time limit and handicaps

痛快！爽快！全開!!
あの11人のキャラがパワーアップして帰ってきた。
